Package org.osgi.test.cases.dmt.tc1.tbc.DmtData

Class TestDmtDataExceptions

java.lang.Object
junit.framework.Assert
junit.framework.TestCase
org.osgi.test.support.OSGiTestCase
org.osgi.test.support.compatibility.DefaultTestBundleControl
org.osgi.test.cases.dmt.tc1.tbc.DmtTestControl
org.osgi.test.cases.dmt.tc1.tbc.DmtData.TestDmtDataExceptions
All Implemented Interfaces:
junit.framework.Test
public class TestDmtDataExceptions extends DmtTestControl
This test case asserts that DmtIllegalStateException is thrown if we try to get a different format from the defined. e.g: Calling DmtData.getFloat() in a DmtData.FORMAT_STRING It also asserts that it is not possible to create a DmtData(String value,int format) if the format is not one of the allowed. (FORMAT_STRING, FORMAT_XML, FORMAT_DATE, FORMAT_TIME). e.g: Calling new DmtData("String",FORMAT_BINARY) Finally, it ensures that the DmtData(String value,int format) must be parseabet an ISO 8601 date or time (in case of FORMAT_DATE or FORMAT_TIME)
